logistics.format: Web-based proctored, open-book reference (ProctorU or PearsonVUE)

recommended_certs.rationale: GCLD でクラウド共通の基礎セキュリティを習得した後、AWS/Azure/GCP 横断の比較知識を扱う GPCS に進むのが SANS のラダー。

plus.note: AWS/Azure/GCP を横断する数少ない第三者評価。

minus.note: クラウド資格人気では CCSP / 各クラウド公式資格に比べ知名度がまだ低い。

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 1, professional: 2. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Recorded multi-cloud coverage and accreditation support professional control decisions across AWS, Azure and GCP; lower peer recognition and an open-book exam limit claims of demonstrated expert implementation.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Accredited coverage across AWS, Azure and GCP supports professional multicloud security judgment. Its two-year profile, open-book assessment and weaker recorded recognition than CCSP limit the inference of senior architecture capability.

alex-novak.rationale: Cross-cloud AWS, Azure and GCP knowledge is valuable, but the record specifies two years and an open-book exam without practical delivery. That supports associate cloud-security breadth rather than demonstrated professional architecture ownership.
